programs.description: Strict patriarch Shivnath restricts his children regarding love and marriage because he fears family fragmentation. Consequently, the youths rebel.
Arnav, a not-so-happy businessman, has a traumatic past. However, when he crosses paths with Ishwari, a carefree girl, his life changes.
Avani, a resolute young woman, prepares for her wedding, giving up her ambitions. However, a startling turn of events transforms her life when she meets Dhanraj.
Nandini and Parth are set to marry, but a tragedy on their wedding day alters their future, forcing them to confront unexpected challenges as they navigate a new, uncertain life together.
Romance blooms when the free-spirited Surya brings fresh hope into Vaidehi's life. But their peace is shattered by a family feud that is much bigger and older than their love.
Avani, a resolute young woman, prepares for her wedding, giving up her ambitions. However, a startling turn of events transforms her life when she meets Dhanraj.
Sisters Bhagyashree and Prajakta stand by each other as they navigate difficult challenges. However, societal expectations and unforeseen circumstances severely test their bond.
The Randives, a close-knit family, face challenges as outsiders try to divide them. Will their strong bonds overcome the conspiracy threatening their unity?
